title: A new site is not left on a bare upstream web image while its IMAGE_TAGS line exists; a site already on one moves to the line for the same base
steps: S1: Resolve joomla:5-apache with lib/web-image.sh as a provision does (TRACY_WEB_IMAGE_BUILD=1), on a host where the line's image is not built (docker stubbed).
S2: Same, with the build failing.
S3: Same without the switch, and in the strict stance.
S4: Source platform/joomla.sh and platform/wordpress.sh on the clone, fresh and quickstart roads and record which bases they resolve.
S5: Run move-off-upstream-image.sh --list over a sites root holding upstream sites with and without a line, then --apply one running site, then --apply with a moved container that fails its checks.
expect: S1: web/build.sh --line joomla:5-apache runs once; stdout is exactly the Tracy image; no output line starts with ==.
S2: stdout is joomla:5-apache; stderr carries the !! block naming build.sh --line and move-off-upstream-image.sh --label <label> --apply.
S3: no build; lenient keeps the upstream base, strict refuses naming build.sh --line.
S4: exactly one base per road: joomla 5-apache / 6-apache / 6-apache, wordpress php8.3-apache / apache.

S5: --list names each upstream site with its target or 'no line: stays, host-browser fallback'; --apply changes only the web image line and recreates web only; a failed check puts the previous compose back.
evidence: 7 customer turns on prod1 answered NO_BROWSER, all Joomla; on the local stand an imported Joomla site ran joomla:5-apache because tracy/web-joomla:5-apache-20261027-r1 was never built there
fence: The resolver's build-on-the-spot path and the mover, driven against a docker stub: the image a new site's compose gets, and the compose lines a move changes

tests: a provision builds the one missing line and answers the Tracy image
a failed build leaves the NEW site on its upstream base, loudly
without the switch (go-live, restore, snapshot source the platform too) nothing is built
each platform file resolves exactly one base per road
build.sh finds the Joomla skill tree beside web/ on a fleet host
--list names each site on a bare upstream image
--apply on a running site: builds the line, changes only the image line
a moved container that does not prove itself is put back
